name: CF Industries

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (CF Industries New Logo.svg)

description: CF Industries makes nitrogen fertilizer and industrial nitrogen products from natural gas: ammonia, granular urea, UAN solution and ammonium nitrate (AN), plus diesel exhaust fluid and nitric acid. It runs eight plants in the US and Canada and one in the UK, and says its North American plants hold about 40% of ammonia, 41% of urea, 44% of UAN and 19% of AN capacity there. It sells to farm co-ops and dealers, industrial customers and exporters at market prices that swing with global nitrogen supply and natural gas costs, so profit moves far more than volume. It is building a low-carbon ammonia plant at Blue Point, Louisiana with Japanese partners JERA and Mitsui who will buy part of the output.

businessLines.name: Ammonia
businessLines.how: Commodity price times tons sold; buyers are retailers, industrial users and exporters; price follows global nitrogen supply and natural gas cost.
businessLines.description: Anhydrous ammonia sold for direct application, as feedstock and for industrial uses; also the building block for the other products.

operatingProfit.note: segment gross margin (CF measures segments by gross margin, not operating profit)

businessLines.name: Granular Urea
businessLines.how: Commodity price times tons; sold to farm retailers and traders, strongest in spring and fall seasons.
businessLines.description: Solid nitrogen fertilizer made from ammonia and CO2.

operatingProfit.note: segment gross margin (CF measures segments by gross margin, not operating profit)

businessLines.name: UAN
businessLines.how: Commodity price times tons; largest by volume; sold mainly to US farm retail and distribution, with a seasonal fill program.
businessLines.description: Liquid urea ammonium nitrate fertilizer solution (about 28-32% nitrogen).

operatingProfit.note: segment gross margin (CF measures segments by gross margin, not operating profit)

businessLines.name: AN (ammonium nitrate)
businessLines.how: Price times tons; agricultural and industrial buyers; UK plant serves UK and European market.
businessLines.description: Ammonium nitrate for farm use and industrial/mining explosives; made in the US (Yazoo City, idled) and UK.

operatingProfit.note: segment gross margin (CF measures segments by gross margin, not operating profit)

businessLines.name: Other
businessLines.how: Price times volume of smaller industrial and environmental nitrogen products.
businessLines.description: DEF (diesel exhaust fluid), urea liquor, nitric acid, aqua ammonia and similar.

operatingProfit.note: segment gross margin (CF measures segments by gross margin, not operating profit)

brands.name: Blue Point Number One, LLC (Blue Point joint venture)
brands.share: CF 40%, JERA 35%, Mitsui 25%; consolidated by CF as primary beneficiary
brands.note: Low-carbon ATR ammonia plant at Modeste, Louisiana; about $3.7B cost; production expected 2029

brands.name: CF Industries Nitrogen, LLC (CFN)
brands.share: CHS holds about 11% minority interest; CF holds the rest

whatsNext.text: Yazoo City, Mississippi complex rebuild after the November 2025 AN-area incident; production of ammonia, AN solution, nitric acid, UAN and urea liquor expected to resume in the first half of 2027
Blue Point low-carbon ammonia plant: construction expected to begin 2026, low-carbon ammonia production expected to begin 2029
